evidence: Verified deterministic projection is a fold over canonical stream order rather than arrival or occurrence-time order.
Verified exact duplicate insertion leaves projection state unchanged, while same-ID/different-content violates identity integrity.
Verified terminal success follows only after accepted work set equals declared obligations, independent of physical attempt count.
Verified lease expiry or heartbeat absence does not imply remote nonexecution, and a higher epoch prevents stale authority only at sinks that enforce it.
Verified code/process rollback does not determine dataset publication or external-effect disposition without separate receipts/reconciliation.

evidence: Reviewed the nine-layer argument: intent identity, work/attempt separation, event integrity/order, guarded transition, rebuildable projection, data-generation evidence, uncertainty preservation, governed observability, and lifecycle recoverability.
Reviewed why deterministic replay requires canonical events and explicit facts rather than live time, mutable configuration, current catalogs, random values, or implicit external lookup.

Reviewed why projection validity and external reconciliation are both necessary after restore; replay consistency alone cannot establish external effects.
